description: This file defines a role service module that provides functions to fetch and resolve user roles from a database (via supabase). It contains helper functions for normalizing role data and exports two main functions: fetchUserRole (to get a user's primary role) and fetchUserRoles (to get all roles for a user).

methods.name: normalizeRole(role)
methods.description: Helper function that normalizes role values, ensuring they are one of 'admin', 'hr', or 'learner'.

methods.name: fetchUserRole(userId)
methods.description: Fetches the primary role of a user, with priority order and fallback to 'learner'. Uses RLS-protected table 'user_roles'.

methods.name: fetchUserRoles(userId)
methods.description: Fetches all roles associated with a user and returns a unique list. Also reads from 'user_roles'.
